question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"mourn". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Mourn" **means to feel or express sorrow or grief.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits with the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example: **After the sudden demise of her father, she took some time off to mourn his loss.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"think", **does not fit the context of the sentence as it does not make sense to **"think" **in this scenario.
 
• Option 2, **"memorise", **is also not appropriate as it does not relate to the situation mentioned in the sentence.
 
• Option 4, **"resist", **does not fit as it is not relevant to the context of the sentence.
